mechanism: Torsemide-induced hypokalemia and volume depletion can potentiate guanfacine's hypotensive and CNS effects, while guanfacine may reduce renal perfusion and affect torsemide efficacy.
action: Monitor blood pressure, electrolytes (especially potassium), and renal function regularly; adjust diuretic or antihypertensive dosing as needed; counsel on orthostatic precautions.
